description: This file defines the AttributeXss class for attribute XSS filtering within the Drupal link module, including methods for sanitizing and filtering HTML attributes to prevent security vulnerabilities.

classes.name: AttributeXss
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for sanitizing HTML attributes to prevent XSS attacks.

methods.name: attributes
methods.description: Parses a string of HTML attributes into an array, filtering out potentially malicious protocols.

methods.name: sanitizeAttributes
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of attributes, ensuring they are safe for output in HTML.
